current_logic.universe_selection: CS_RANK screening with anchor/macro loading; universe selection is preprocessing, not a search target.
current_logic.regime_classification: Posterior-first HMM inference produces p_bull/p_bear/p_chop/p_crisis plus entropy; hard labels are telemetry only.
current_logic.alpha_generation: LightGBM v6 alpha is regime-conditional, with chop-fragility filtering and soft downweighting.
current_logic.signal_combination: Posterior-aware long/short multipliers and EV hurdles convert regime probabilities into executable allowances.
current_logic.risk_management: Regime policy drives gross scaling, crisis suppression, and turnover throttling in backtest and execution.
current_logic.portfolio_optimization: AWF/TPE maximizes compounding with chop/turnover penalties and deployability gates, controlled by ops profiles.

key_parameters.objective_function: mean(log_TW) - lambda_mad * semi_dev - psi_dd * worst_mdd - chop_loss_penalty - chop_trade_penalty - turnover_penalty
